invariants.rationale: The method passes config to another method that likely expects a valid configuration object; null config would likely cause failure.
Returning null for a table instance is unlikely; method delegates to a factory expected to create a table every time.
It is common for factory-created objects to expose the configuration object used during their construction, and this relationship should hold.
The delegate factory method is HoodieJavaTable::create, and so the returned object should be an instance of HoodieJavaTable.
